result.instructions: Local stdio MCP entry (permission scope 'local-single', transport 'stdio'). Tool calls are dispatched against a closed allowlist; no shell is exposed. Long tasks return an operation/job reference that survives disconnection; query it with acp_status.

tools.name: acp_capabilities
tools.description: List the capabilities (workflows/backends/limits) the service currently offers, including the extension handshake (extensions[]: id/version/supported/requested/negotiated_by/implemented/negotiated/refusal).

research_extension.description: Optional application-level extension handshake. The server answers extensions[] with implemented/negotiated/refusal; a version that is not the supported one is refused in-band as unsupported_capability, never accepted by implication.

version.description: Requested extension version; omit to accept the supported one.

project_id.description: Advisory Workspace hint checked against the server-resolved project; a mismatch is access_denied and the hint never selects the scope.

client.description: Client identifier recorded for audit only; never used for authorization.

tools.name: acp_preflight
tools.description: Preflight/estimate a request with zero side effects (no science, no metering).

inputSchema.description: Preflight/estimate descriptor: the same declared fields as acp_submit, with zero side effects (no task, no reservation, no metering). idempotency_key is optional here because nothing is created.

schema_version.description: Contract major version; any other value executes nothing.

target_node.description: Pin one execution target ('local' or a configured remote node).

preflight_fingerprint.description: Optional binding to the plan digest a preflight returned.

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED. Client retry key, forwarded unchanged to the Controller ledger. The raw key is a global namespace per action (across projects/users): use a high-entropy UUID or a namespaced key (e.g. '<client>:<project>:<round>:<call>'). A short human key reused by two tenants is a typed conflict (revision_conflict), never a replay. Same key + same verified identity + same request = exactly one operation. Omitting it is refused with input_invalid (rule=idempotency_key_required).

extensions.description: Namespaced extension metadata (never used for execution).

plan_digest.description: Research-launch switch (sha256:<64 hex>). Its presence makes this a research submit, which requires proposal_ref plus a matching server approval; a bare plan_digest without proposal_ref is denied with 403 approval_required. Omit it, together with proposal_ref/proposal_digest/budget, for a legacy launch.

proposal_ref.description: Approval-bound proposal reference required for a research launch; must have an approved record for this plan_digest and project (server-verified).

proposal_digest.description: Optional research binding (sha256:<64 hex>); when supplied it must equal the approved proposal projection digest.

budget.description: Optional research budget request; when supplied it must equal the approved budget binding (the effective limits come from the approval, never the client).

tools.name: acp_submit
tools.description: Controlled submit; returns an operation/job reference immediately (long task).

inputSchema.description: Submit descriptor. Legacies and research launches share this schema; the field relations below are documented for callers, never enforced here — the Controller remains the gate. idempotency_key is required (M1-01b): an undeclared field is a typed input_invalid (rule=unknown_field) and a missing key is input_invalid (rule=idempotency_key_required) before any budget or Controller call. plan_digest is the research-launch switch: supplying it (or any of proposal_ref/proposal_digest/budget) makes the submit a research launch, which additionally requires proposal_ref bound to a server-side approval and optionally proposal_digest/budget. Omitting all four keeps the legacy path. A research submit without proposal_ref is refused by the Controller with access_denied (rule=approval_required) before idempotency or admission.

schema_version.description: Contract major version; any other value executes nothing.

target_node.description: Pin one execution target ('local' or a configured remote node).

preflight_fingerprint.description: Optional binding to the plan digest a preflight returned.

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED. Client retry key, forwarded unchanged to the Controller ledger. The raw key is a global namespace per action (across projects/users): use a high-entropy UUID or a namespaced key (e.g. '<client>:<project>:<round>:<call>'). A short human key reused by two tenants is a typed conflict (revision_conflict), never a replay. Same key + same verified identity + same request = exactly one operation. Omitting it is refused with input_invalid (rule=idempotency_key_required).

Its presence makes this a research submit, which requires proposal_ref plus a matching server approval; a bare plan_digest without proposal_ref is denied with 403 approval_required. Omit it, together with proposal_ref/proposal_digest/budget, for a legacy launch.

proposal_digest.description: Optional research binding (sha256:<64 hex>); when supplied it must equal the approved proposal projection digest.

tools.name: acp_status
tools.description: Query the status of an operation/job reference. Holds no connection state.

reference.description: Operation/job reference returned by acp_submit (id or {kind,id}).

tools.name: acp_cancel
tools.description: Request cancellation of an operation/job reference.

reference.description: Operation/job reference returned by acp_submit (id or {kind,id}).

tools.name: acp_prepare_artifact
tools.description: Prepare an artifact for read; idempotent and budget-checked server-side.

inputSchema.description: Explicit prepare request, identical to POST /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/prepare. purpose is required; artifact_id is required when purpose=artifact. The Controller derives resource_id from artifact_id, never from the caller. A prepare never starts science and is never implied by a read or a status query.

purpose.description: Required. artifact = fetch/commit one artifact revision; structure-input = local parse+register with no task.

task_ref.description: Alternate task reference; task_ref.task_id must equal the job id in the route path and supplies the default attempt.

job_id.description: Must equal the job id in the route path; a mismatch is revision_conflict.

artifact_id.description: Required when purpose=artifact. Safe artifact token; the Controller derives resource_id from it.

expected_revision.description: Declared and normalised for CAS-style callers; the prepare route does not act on it.

expected_digest.description: Trusted sha256:<64 hex> expectation; a mismatch is conflict.

idempotency_key.description: Client retry key for the prepare operation, forwarded unchanged. The server derives the versioned key from (principal, project, client key, epoch). Omitting it is NOT idempotent: a retry may re-prepare.

tools.name: acp_read_artifact
tools.description: Read an already-prepared artifact (bounded; no fetch on miss).

inputSchema.description: Bounded read of an already-prepared artifact. artifact_ref is required; a miss is resource_not_ready and a read never fetches, prepares or starts computation (M1-01b). max_bytes above the frozen max_read_bytes bound is refused (input_invalid, rule=max_read_bytes_exceeded) instead of served.

max_bytes.description: Requested response bound (<= 1048576 bytes). A larger request is refused rather than silently clamped.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension metadata (never used for execution).

tools.name: acp_analyze
tools.description: Run an explicit analysis request (requires analysis_id, input_refs, explicit=true).

inputSchema.description: Explicit analysis request. analysis_id, input_refs and explicit=true are required: an implicit/heuristic trigger is refused (input_invalid, rule=explicit_required); an unregistered capability is unsupported_capability (rule=analysis_capability_not_registered) and a declared-but-not-executable one is unsupported_capability (rule=analysis_capability_not_executable). Each input_refs entry must be the full ArtifactRef identity tuple (task_id/attempt/artifact_id/generation/digest) of an already prepared artifact. vibration.analyze reads existing evidence and starts no QC; vibration.compute is a compute capability (submit it as a frequency task) and is never a read-only analysis.

explicit.description: Must be exactly true; there is no implicit analysis.

plan_digest.description: Required for vibration.compute (it starts exactly one task).

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key for analysis; omitting it is not idempotent.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension metadata (never used for execution).
